description: This is a source file defining the LocalDb class, which manages the local SQLite database for an attendance tracking application. It provides methods for initialization and clearing data, handling platform-specific setup with sqflite and FFI.

classes.name: LocalDb
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the local SQLite database connection and provides methods for initializing and clearing the database.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the database, setting up FFI on desktop platforms, and creating the attendance table with an index.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Deletes all records from the attendance table, mainly used for development or testing purposes.

calls: db.execute('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attendance_date ON attendance(date)')
